paragraphs: Nittai of Arbel. Arbel is a place, Beit Arbel, Hosea 10; it is Samaria. Some say a place near Nineveh. Avot 1; Mishnah, Elu Doreshin 16a. He was court head, among הזונות [apparent source difficulty; perhaps 'the pairs']; see R. Yehoshua ben Peraḥyah. He is buried at Arbel, between Tzippori and Tiberias. מ״ב, Vayishlaḥ [work unresolved], says Dinah is buried at Arbel, with Nittai beside her. גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael] says Nittai and R. Zeira are buried there; in the field lie four tribes and Dinah their sister, and Shet, Adam's son.
